cte-recursive-select: WITH "recent_hires" AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT "employees"."id", "employees"."name", "employees"."hired_at" FROM "employees" WHERE "employees"."hired_at" >= :q1), "salary_totals" AS (SELECT "salaries"."employee_id", SUM("salaries"."amount") AS total_paid FROM "salaries" GROUP BY "salaries"."employee_id" HAVING SUM(salaries.amount) >= :q2) SELECT "recent_hires"."id", "recent_hires"."name", COALESCE("salary_totals"."total_paid", 0) AS total_paid FROM "recent_hires" LEFT JOIN "salary_totals" ON "recent_hires"."id" = "salary_totals"."employee_id" ORDER BY "total_paid" DESC
